# GCP 가이드라인 검색기

> Unofficial Korean lookup for ICH GCP, FDA clinical trial guidance (Part 11, eSource, informed consent), MFDS notices, and KGCP (Korea GMP-adjacent clinical trial standards in the Safety Rules Annex 4).

- Site: https://gcp-guidance-search.vercel.app
- Language: Korean UI. Source passages may be English FDA/ICH text with on-demand Korean rendering.
- Not official legal advice. Always open the linked FDA, MFDS, or Korean Law source.

## What it answers
- Audit trails / electronic records / 21 CFR Part 11
- Informed consent of trial subjects (ICH E6 4.8, 21 CFR 50)
- Risk-based monitoring
- Electronic source data (eSource)
- Korean KGCP (의약품 등의 안전에 관한 규칙 별표 4) and related statutes

## Limits
- Seeded excerpts of ICH E6(R2), not the full E6(R3) PDF
- No OCR for scanned PDFs
- Answers are extractive from loaded chunks only
